system.description:
SOUL UTILITY WARDING
Tradition divinity
Cast 3 AP (somatic, verbal)
Range 30 feet
Targets 1 possessed creature

You invoke divine authority against an entity occupying a body or soul that is not its own.
Attempt to Counteract the possession.
Critical: The possession ends. The possessing entity cannot attempt to possess the same creature again for 24 hours.
Success: The possession ends. The entity cannot attempt to possess the same creature again for 1 minute.
Failure: The possession remains.
Fumble: The possession remains and you cannot attempt to Exorcise that possession again until the beginning of your next turn.
Ending the possession does not destroy the possessing entity. If it can normally manifest outside the host, resolve its separation according to the possession effect.

Warping Options:
+1 PP: Gain a +1-circumstance bonus to the Counteract check (max +12).

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10. The Counteract is rolled (enter the possessor's level) and its rung printed; ending the possession is the GM's.
